inventory.objective: Opit kirjoittamaan tilanteen lyhyesti numeroilla ja merkeillä.
inventory.intro: Aava records a thought briefly in numbers and signs.
demo: signScene(kala,3,2,+): incoming objects, sign and equation
translateScene: five = eight minus three, chunk by chunk

families.add: choose scene-matching equation; signScene(...,false) conceals operation/result notation
families.compare: choose a<b/a>b with Loikka first, a≠b; pairing model
families.words: choose symbolic version of more/less verbal comparison
families.build: build/fact addition or subtraction story, reusable number and sign tokens; max7
families.transfer: choose k×g for shell array; k=2..4,g=2..5 adjusted if equal

hints: compare: smaller value and sign tip
transfer: row count and equal row size
inventory.audit: LESSON_AUDIT: add must not reveal +; pairing replaces hard-to-compare static rows; translateScene and specific why/hint updates. Actual code includes build too.
inventory.sourceContract: sameFact checks a true equality with the same numeric/operator token bag; accepts swapped equation sides and commuted addition; it is not an unrestricted context-semantic judge.

registry.limit: Recognition and build token composition; no free-writing observation.

planning.teacherObjective: Esittää tutun yhteen- tai vähennyslaskutilanteen määrien yhteyden totena yhtälönä merkkipaloista; tulkita luvut ja yhtäsuuruus.
planning.childGoal: Esitän tutun tilanteen numeroilla ja merkeillä.
assumed: Core: M-ADD-01, M-SYM-PLUS, M-SYM-EQUAL (relevant content/symbol knowledge); aided picture/count available.
Subtraction worked/transfer branch: M-SUB-01 and M-SYM-MINUS.
Comparison/multiplication only optional later paths, with their own content prerequisites stated; do not silently require M-MUL-01/02 for core.
planning.scope: Kaksi rajattua sisältöesimerkkiä: 3+2=5 ja 6−2=4 sekä samojen lukujen ja tämän kierroksen laskumerkin kaikki todet yhtälömuodot. Pääpaletti vain numerot, + tai − ja =. Ei <,>,×-käyttöä, vapaata käsinkirjoitusta tai kaikkien esittämissisältöjen arviointia.
planning.evidenceLimits: Tuttu sisältö ja symbolit ovat tehtäväkohtaisia oletuksia. Merkkipalojen bounded yhtälö ei osoita vapaata kirjoitustaitoa, laskutaidon riippumattomuutta tai yleistä esittämisen hallintaa. No persistence, mastery awards, efficacy claim or human validation.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Frozen canonical band/roles/groups/relations retained. Foreign educational guidance corroborates design; it is not new Finnish OPS evidence. Story, numerical bounds, original diagrams, manual steps and constructive checks are project design.

assetProvenance.origin: Original subject diagram authored for this KC on2026-10-29; no copied research-source figures.

assetProvenance.display: Named static introduction at96×96, no decorative motion or new pose.

planning.interactionType: Select reusable numeral/sign tokens into a local expression strip; undo/clear/check; show a concrete story and ask for its mathematical relation, not a fixed chronological word order.
planning.support: Optional map number↔pictured quantity and sign meanings; no confirmation of oral reading.
planning.offline: Make number/sign cards; a child arranges a note for an enacted situation, adult asks what each part means.
planning.advanced: Optional familiar multiplication or inequality context only with explicit item-specific assumptions.
planning.accessibility: Native buttons >=48px target in scoped CSS; explicit aria labels and pressed states, visible chosen targets, polite feedback; no drag, mandatory audio, speech check, object-name production or timed response. Manual model steps; root controls disable while paused.
planning.reviewStatus: Revised after independent Hume P2 finding; author targeted regression checks passed. Targeted independent rereview, main integration and human testing remain separate.
